Who We Help  /  Small Businesses

We help small businesses cut through the noise and put tech to work.

We help small businesses...

Optimize existing technology

We help you get the most out of the investments you've made in Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and other tools. We also make sure your vendors deliver what they promised.

Explore AI and automation

AI isn't magic, but with the right guidance it definitely can make you more efficient. We'll help you figure out where it actually makes sense for your business.

Get more value from data

You already have valuable data. We work with you to benefit from the insights and value that's sitting in your systems right now.

Make the right investments

Cut through the smoke and mirrors. We evaluate vendors, help you figure out ROI, and make sure you're spending money on what actually matters.

How we work with small businesses

We work hard to provide the flexibility small businesses need. If you're thinking something else, let us know and we'll work together to find something that works.

  • Needs Assessment Often the first step in our process. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of your current technology ecosystem and deliver an actionable set of recommendations.
  • Targeted Sprints Short-term, focused support to solve an immediate business need — such as vendor evaluation, staff training, or system setup.
  • Project Work End-to-end execution for specific business initiatives or technical projects, ranging from a few hours of work to a multi-month engagement.
  • Ongoing Partnership Following a brief onboarding, we provide continuous technical and strategic support to ensure your technology scales seamlessly with your business.

Technology help for people, and their businesses, organizations, and communities.
